import numpy as np

def ses_forecast(y, alpha=0.3):
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
    if y.ndim != 1 or not len(y) or not np.isfinite(y).all() or not 0 <= alpha <= 1:
        raise ValueError('Série finie non vide et alpha dans [0,1] requis.')
    level = y[0]
    for value in y[1:]:
        level = alpha*value + (1-alpha)*level
    return float(level)

def select_best(results):
    eligible = [row for row in results if row.get('converged', True) and np.isfinite(row['MAE'])]
    if not eligible:
        raise ValueError('Aucun modèle convergé avec un score fini.')
    return min(eligible, key=lambda row: row['MAE']).copy()

def residual_model_df(order, seasonal_order):
    p, d, q = order
    P, D, Q, m = seasonal_order
    return p+q+P+Q

import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.holtwinters import SimpleExpSmoothing, Holt, ExponentialSmoothing
from statsmodels.tsa.exponential_smoothing.ets import ETSModel
from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import acorr_ljungbox

CANDIDATES = [((0,1,1),(0,1,1,12)), ((1,1,1),(0,1,1,12)),
              ((1,1,0),(1,1,0,12)), ((1,0,1),(1,1,0,12))]

def dataset():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    t = np.arange(96)
    dates = pd.date_range('2018-01-01', periods=96, freq='MS')
    sales = 100+0.8*t+20*np.sin(2*np.pi*t/12)+rng.normal(0,5,96)
    series = pd.Series(sales,index=dates,name='sales')
    # Promotion planifiée à l'avance : variable connue à chaque origine.
    exog = pd.DataFrame({'promotion': (dates.month==12).astype(float)},index=dates)
    return series, exog

def fit_candidate(train, order, seasonal_order, exog=None):
    fit = SARIMAX(train,exog=exog,order=order,seasonal_order=seasonal_order,
                  enforce_stationarity=True,enforce_invertibility=True).fit(disp=False,maxiter=150)
    if not fit.mle_retvals.get('converged',False):
        raise ValueError('Optimisation non convergée : configuration écartée.')
    return fit

def run(plot=False):
    series, exog = dataset()
    train, validation, test = series.iloc[:72],series.iloc[72:84],series.iloc[84:]
    # Comparaison descriptive sur la même validation ; pas de classement AIC entre familles.
    fitted = {
        'SES': SimpleExpSmoothing(train,initialization_method='estimated').fit(),
        'Holt': Holt(train,initialization_method='estimated').fit(),
        'Holt-Winters': ExponentialSmoothing(train,trend='add',seasonal='add',seasonal_periods=12).fit(),
        'ETS(A,A,A)': ETSModel(train,error='add',trend='add',seasonal='add',seasonal_periods=12).fit(disp=False),
        'ARIMA(1,1,1)': ARIMA(train,order=(1,1,1)).fit()}
    rows = [{'Model':name,'MAE':float(np.abs(validation-fit.forecast(12)).mean())}
            for name,fit in fitted.items()]
    rows.append({'Model':'Naïve saisonnière','MAE':float(np.abs(validation.to_numpy()-train.iloc[-12:].to_numpy()).mean())})
    print('Comparaison descriptive, validation uniquement :')
    print(pd.DataFrame(rows).round(3).to_string(index=False))
    results=[]
    for order, seasonal in CANDIDATES:
        try:
            fit=fit_candidate(train,order,seasonal)
            pred=fit.forecast(12)
            results.append({'order':order,'seasonal_order':seasonal,'converged':True,
                            'MAE':float(np.abs(validation-pred).mean()),'AIC':fit.aic,'BIC':fit.bic})
        except (ValueError,ArithmeticError,np.linalg.LinAlgError) as error:
            print('Configuration écartée :',order,seasonal,error)
    best=select_best(results)  # Minimum MAE ; l'ordre de la liste ne décide pas du choix.
    print('Candidat SARIMA choisi sur validation :',best)
    development=series.iloc[:84]
    final_fit=fit_candidate(development,best['order'],best['seasonal_order'])
    result=final_fit.get_forecast(len(test))
    pred=result.predicted_mean
    intervals=result.conf_int(alpha=0.05)
    baseline=np.resize(development.iloc[-12:].to_numpy(),len(test))
    mae=float(np.abs(test-pred).mean())
    print('Audit test SARIMA MAE / RMSE :',mae,float(np.sqrt(np.mean((test-pred)**2))))
    print('Audit test baseline MAE :',float(np.abs(test.to_numpy()-baseline).mean()))
    print('Couverture descriptive sur 12 mois :',float(((test>=intervals.iloc[:,0]) & (test<=intervals.iloc[:,1])).mean()))
    # Les paramètres AR et MA saisonniers sont inclus dans l'ajustement des degrés de liberté.
    burn=max(final_fit.loglikelihood_burn,12)
    residuals=final_fit.resid.iloc[burn:].dropna()
    model_df=residual_model_df(best['order'],best['seasonal_order'])
    lb=acorr_ljungbox(residuals,lags=[12,18],model_df=model_df,return_df=True)
    print('Ljung-Box, model_df =',model_df,'; résidus écartés =',burn)
    print(lb)
    # Illustration SARIMAX : configuration fixée, exog connue ; comparaison sur validation.
    with_exog=fit_candidate(train,(0,1,1),(0,1,1,12),exog.iloc[:72])
    exog_pred=with_exog.get_forecast(12,exog=exog.iloc[72:84]).predicted_mean
    print('SARIMAX validation MAE :',float(np.abs(validation-exog_pred).mean()))
    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,5))
        ax.plot(development.index,development,label='Historique')
        ax.plot(test.index,test,label='Réel')
        ax.plot(pred.index,pred,'--',label='SARIMA')
        ax.fill_between(pred.index,intervals.iloc[:,0],intervals.iloc[:,1],alpha=.2,label='Intervalle prédictif nominal 95 %')
        ax.legend();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
        final_fit.plot_diagnostics(figsize=(12,8));plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
    return {'best':best,'MAE':mae,'predictions':pred,'intervals':intervals,'ljung_box':lb}

if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--plot',action='store_true')
    run(parser.parse_args().plot)

lessons.code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

FEATURES=['lag_1','lag_7','lag_14','lag_28','rolling_mean_7','rolling_std_7','day_of_week','month','is_weekend']

def create_features_for_future(df):
    if not isinstance(df.index,pd.DatetimeIndex) or not df.index.is_monotonic_increasing or not df.index.is_unique:
        raise ValueError('Dates uniques et triées requises.')
    if len(df)>1 and not (df.index.to_series().diff().iloc[1:]==pd.Timedelta(days=1)).all():
        raise ValueError('Calendrier journalier régulier requis ; traiter les dates absentes.')
    data=df.copy()
    for lag in [1,7,14,28]:
        data[f'lag_{lag}']=data['sales'].shift(lag)
    past=data['sales'].shift(1)
    data['rolling_mean_7']=past.rolling(7).mean()
    data['rolling_std_7']=past.rolling(7).std()
    data['day_of_week']=data.index.dayofweek
    data['month']=data.index.month
    data['is_weekend']=(data.index.dayofweek>=5).astype(int)
    return data

def create_features(df):
    return create_features_for_future(df).dropna(subset=FEATURES+['sales'])

def recursive_forecast(model,history,horizon,feature_cols=FEATURES):
    if not isinstance(horizon,(int,np.integer)) or horizon<1:
        raise ValueError('Horizon entier positif requis.')
    history=history[['sales']].copy()
    if len(history)<28 or not np.isfinite(history['sales']).all():
        raise ValueError('Au moins 28 observations finies requises.')
    predictions=[]
    for step in range(horizon):
        next_date=history.index[-1]+pd.Timedelta(days=1)
        future=pd.DataFrame({'sales':[np.nan]},index=[next_date])
        data=create_features_for_future(pd.concat([history,future]))
        X_next=data.loc[[next_date],feature_cols]
        if not np.isfinite(X_next.to_numpy(dtype=float)).all():
            raise ValueError('Features futures incomplètes.')
        pred=float(model.predict(X_next)[0])
        if not np.isfinite(pred):
            raise ValueError('Prévision non finie.')
        history.loc[next_date,'sales']=pred
        predictions.append(pred)
    return pd.Series(predictions,index=pd.date_range(history.index[-horizon],periods=horizon,freq='D'),name='prediction')

def direct_targets(df,horizon=3):
    # Ligne datée t : origine t-1 ; cible de l'horizon h = Y[t+h-1].
    data=create_features_for_future(df)
    columns=[]
    for h in range(1,horizon+1):
        name=f'target_{h}';data[name]=data['sales'].shift(-(h-1));columns.append(name)
    return data.dropna(subset=FEATURES+columns)

def dataset():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(42);t=np.arange(1000)
    sales=100+.03*t+20*np.sin(2*np.pi*t/7)+10*np.sin(2*np.pi*t/365.25)+rng.normal(0,5,len(t))
    return pd.DataFrame({'sales':sales},index=pd.date_range('2022-01-01',periods=len(t),freq='D'))

def make_model(engine='lightgbm',iterations=200):
    if engine=='lightgbm':
        from lightgbm import LGBMRegressor
        return LGBMRegressor(n_estimators=iterations,learning_rate=.03,num_leaves=15,random_state=42,verbosity=-1,n_jobs=1)
    if engine=='browser':
        from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
        return RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=60,max_depth=8,random_state=42,n_jobs=1)
    raise ValueError('Moteur inconnu.')

def run(plot=False,engine='lightgbm'):
    from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error,mean_squared_error
    from sklearn.model_selection import TimeSeriesSplit
    df=dataset();data=create_features(df)
    a,b=int(len(data)*.70),int(len(data)*.85)
    train,validation,test=data.iloc[:a],data.iloc[a:b],data.iloc[b:]
    model=make_model(engine,500)
    if engine=='lightgbm':
        import lightgbm as lgb
        model.fit(train[FEATURES],train['sales'],eval_set=[(validation[FEATURES],validation['sales'])],
                  eval_metric='l1',callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(30,verbose=False)])
        iterations=max(1,model.best_iteration_)
    else:
        model.fit(train[FEATURES],train['sales']);iterations=60
    # Modèle final et réglage fixés avant l'audit test.
    development=data.iloc[:b]
    model=make_model(engine,iterations);model.fit(development[FEATURES],development['sales'])
    pred=model.predict(test[FEATURES])
    baseline=df['sales'].shift(7).loc[test.index]
    scores={'MAE':mean_absolute_error(test['sales'],pred),'RMSE':np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(test['sales'],pred)),
            'baseline_MAE':mean_absolute_error(test['sales'],baseline)}
    print('Test à un pas, historique actualisé :',scores)
    history=df.loc[df.index<test.index[0]]
    recursive=recursive_forecast(model,history,14)
    fixed_baseline=np.resize(history['sales'].iloc[-7:].to_numpy(),14)
    print('Origine fixe 14 jours, MAE modèle / baseline :',mean_absolute_error(df.loc[recursive.index,'sales'],recursive),
          mean_absolute_error(df.loc[recursive.index,'sales'],fixed_baseline))
    # Folds uniquement dans le développement : aucun tuning sur le test final.
    folds=[]
    for tr,va in TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=3,test_size=70).split(development):
        fold_model=make_model(engine,iterations)
        fold_model.fit(development[FEATURES].iloc[tr],development['sales'].iloc[tr])
        folds.append(mean_absolute_error(development['sales'].iloc[va],fold_model.predict(development[FEATURES].iloc[va])))
    print('MAE par fold à un pas :',folds)
    print('Importance native, association et non causalité :',dict(zip(FEATURES,model.feature_importances_)))
    # Extension directe / multi-output : ne garder que les cibles disponibles avant la frontière.
    multi=direct_targets(df.loc[df.index<test.index[0]],3)
    print('Exemples multi-output sur développement :',multi.shape)
    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        plt.figure(figsize=(12,4));plt.plot(test.index,test['sales'],label='Réel')
        plt.plot(test.index,pred,label=engine+' à un pas',alpha=.8);plt.legend();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
    return {'scores':scores,'recursive':recursive,'fold_MAE':folds}

if __name__=='__main__':

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def rolling_zscore(values,window=28):
    series=pd.Series(values,dtype=float).copy()
    if not isinstance(window,int) or window<2:raise ValueError('Fenêtre entière >= 2 requise.')
    past=series.shift(1);mean=past.rolling(window).mean();std=past.rolling(window).std()
    return (series-mean)/std.replace(0,np.nan)

def robust_zscore(values):
    values=np.asarray(values,dtype=float)
    if values.ndim!=1 or not len(values) or not np.isfinite(values).all():raise ValueError('Vecteur fini non vide requis.')
    median=np.median(values);mad=np.median(np.abs(values-median))
    if mad==0:return np.where(values==median,0.,np.copysign(np.inf,values-median))
    return .6745*(values-median)/mad

def cusum_detector(values,target_mean,k,h):
    values=np.asarray(values,dtype=float)
    if values.ndim!=1 or not np.isfinite(values).all() or not np.isfinite([target_mean,k,h]).all() or k<0 or h<=0:
        raise ValueError('Données finies, k>=0 et h>0 requis.')
    positive=negative=0.;alerts=[]
    for t,value in enumerate(values):
        positive=max(0.,positive+value-target_mean-k)
        negative=max(0.,negative+target_mean-value-k)
        if positive>h or negative>h:
            alerts.append(t);positive=negative=0.
    return alerts

def population_stability_index(reference,current,bins=10,epsilon=1e-6):
    reference,current=[np.asarray(v,dtype=float) for v in (reference,current)]
    if any(v.ndim!=1 or not len(v) or not np.isfinite(v).all() for v in (reference,current)) or bins<2 or epsilon<=0:
        raise ValueError('Distributions finies non vides et paramètres valides requis.')
    # Frontières apprises sur la référence ; bornes infinies pour conserver les nouvelles valeurs extrêmes.
    inner=np.unique(np.quantile(reference,np.linspace(0,1,bins+1)[1:-1]))
    edges=np.r_[-np.inf,inner,np.inf]
    p=np.histogram(reference,edges)[0].astype(float);q=np.histogram(current,edges)[0].astype(float)
    p=np.maximum(p/p.sum(),epsilon);q=np.maximum(q/q.sum(),epsilon);p/=p.sum();q/=q.sum()
    return float(np.sum((p-q)*np.log(p/q)))

def run(plot=False):
    from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import STL
    from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest
    from scipy.stats import ks_2samp,wasserstein_distance
    import ruptures as rpt
    rng=np.random.default_rng(42);n=400;t=np.arange(n)
    values=100+.02*t+8*np.sin(2*np.pi*t/7)+rng.normal(0,3,n)
    values[250:]+=25;values[80]+=45;values[320]-=40
    df=pd.DataFrame({'value':values},index=pd.date_range('2025-01-01',periods=n,freq='D'))
    df['z']=rolling_zscore(df['value'],28);df['anomaly']=df['z'].abs()>3
    reference=df['value'].iloc[:60]
    alerts=cusum_detector(df['value'],reference.mean(),k=4,h=35)
    print('Alertes CUSUM, seuils fixés à l’avance :',alerts)
    # Rétrospectif : STL et PELT exploitent la série complète.
    stl=STL(df['value'],period=7,robust=True).fit();signal=df['value'].to_numpy()-stl.seasonal.to_numpy()
    breakpoints=rpt.Pelt(model='l2',min_size=30).fit(signal).predict(pen=300)
    binary=rpt.Binseg(model='l2',min_size=30).fit(signal).predict(n_bkps=1)
    print('PELT rétrospectif (fin du signal incluse) :',breakpoints,'Binary Segmentation :',binary)
    df['rolling_mean']=df['value'].shift(1).rolling(28).mean();df['rolling_std']=df['value'].shift(1).rolling(28).std()
    features=['value','rolling_mean','rolling_std'];clean=df.dropna(subset=features)
    train=clean.loc[clean.index<df.index[70]];test=clean.loc[clean.index>=df.index[70]]
    model=IsolationForest(n_estimators=100,contamination=.03,random_state=42).fit(train[features])
    print('Isolation Forest :',int((model.predict(test[features])==-1).sum()),'alertes après observation courante.')
    current=df['value'].iloc[300:]
    print('Drift descriptif : PSI',population_stability_index(reference,current),'KS',ks_2samp(reference,current).statistic,
          'Wasserstein',wasserstein_distance(reference,current))
    print('Tests KS usuels : dépendance sérielle et tests multiples à considérer avant interprétation des p-values.')
    actual=np.zeros(n,dtype=bool);actual[[80,320]]=True;detected=df['anomaly'].to_numpy()
    tp=np.sum(actual&detected);fp=np.sum(~actual&detected);fn=np.sum(actual&~detected)
    print('Pics injectés : TP/FP/FN',tp,fp,fn,'; changement durable évalué séparément autour de 250.')
    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        plt.figure(figsize=(12,5));plt.plot(df.index,values,label='Signal')
        plt.scatter(df.index[detected],values[detected],color='red',label='Rolling Z')
        for bp in breakpoints[:-1]:plt.axvline(df.index[bp],color='orange',linestyle='--')
        plt.legend();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
    return {'breakpoints':breakpoints,'alerts':alerts}

if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--plot',action='store_true');run(parser.parse_args().plot)

import numpy as np

def soft_vote(probabilities,weights=None):
    probabilities=np.asarray(probabilities,dtype=float)
    if probabilities.ndim!=2 or not probabilities.size or not np.isfinite(probabilities).all() or np.any((probabilities<0)|(probabilities>1)):
        raise ValueError('Matrice observations x modèles de probabilités requise.')
    weights=np.ones(probabilities.shape[1]) if weights is None else np.asarray(weights,dtype=float)
    if weights.shape!=(probabilities.shape[1],) or not np.isfinite(weights).all() or np.any(weights<0) or weights.sum()<=0:
        raise ValueError('Poids positifs ou nuls, somme strictement positive requise.')
    return probabilities@weights/weights.sum()

def hard_vote(predictions):
    predictions=np.asarray(predictions)
    if predictions.ndim!=2 or not predictions.size or not np.isin(predictions,[0,1]).all():raise ValueError('Prédictions binaires requises.')
    # Convention explicite : égalité en faveur de la classe 0.
    return (predictions.mean(axis=1)>.5).astype(int)

def generate_oof(estimator,X,y,splits):
    from sklearn.base import clone
    X,y=np.asarray(X),np.asarray(y)
    if len(X)!=len(y) or not np.isin(y,[0,1]).all():raise ValueError('Cible binaire alignée requise.')
    predictions=np.full(len(y),np.nan);visits=np.zeros(len(y),dtype=int)
    for train_idx,val_idx in splits:
        train_idx,val_idx=np.asarray(train_idx),np.asarray(val_idx)
        if np.intersect1d(train_idx,val_idx).size or not len(train_idx) or not len(val_idx):raise ValueError('Folds disjoints non vides requis.')
        if np.any(train_idx<0) or np.any(val_idx<0) or np.any(train_idx>=len(y)) or np.any(val_idx>=len(y)) or np.any(visits[val_idx]):
            raise ValueError('Indices valides et une seule visite par observation requis.')
        fitted=clone(estimator).fit(X[train_idx],y[train_idx])
        column=np.flatnonzero(fitted.classes_==1)
        if len(column)!=1:raise ValueError('Chaque train doit contenir la classe positive.')
        predictions[val_idx]=fitted.predict_proba(X[val_idx])[:,column[0]];visits[val_idx]+=1
    if not np.all(visits==1):raise ValueError('Toutes les observations doivent recevoir une prédiction OOF.')
    return predictions

def run(plot=False):
    import pandas as pd
    from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
    from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split,StratifiedKFold
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier,HistGradientBoostingClassifier,VotingClassifier,StackingClassifier
    from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
    from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
    from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
    from sklearn.base import clone
    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score,log_loss,accuracy_score
    X,y=make_classification(n_samples=1800,n_features=20,n_informative=12,n_redundant=4,random_state=42)
    dev,test=train_test_split(np.arange(len(y)),test_size=.2,stratify=y,random_state=42)
    train,val=train_test_split(dev,test_size=.25,stratify=y[dev],random_state=42)
    Xtr,ytr=X[train],y[train]
    estimators=[('lr',make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))),
                ('rf',RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=70,random_state=42,n_jobs=1)),
                ('hgb',HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=80,random_state=42))]
    cv=StratifiedKFold(3,shuffle=True,random_state=42);splits=list(cv.split(Xtr,ytr))
    Z=np.column_stack([generate_oof(model,Xtr,ytr,splits) for name,model in estimators])
    meta=LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(Z,ytr)
    bases=[clone(model).fit(Xtr,ytr) for name,model in estimators]
    candidates={name:model for (name,_),model in zip(estimators,bases)}
    candidates['Soft Voting']=VotingClassifier(estimators=estimators,voting='soft').fit(Xtr,ytr)
    candidates['Hard Voting']=VotingClassifier(estimators=estimators,voting='hard').fit(Xtr,ytr)
    candidates['Stacking sklearn']=StackingClassifier(estimators=estimators,final_estimator=LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000),cv=splits,stack_method='predict_proba').fit(Xtr,ytr)
    base_idx,blend_idx=train_test_split(np.arange(len(ytr)),test_size=.25,stratify=ytr,random_state=42)
    blend_bases=[clone(model).fit(Xtr[base_idx],ytr[base_idx]) for name,model in estimators]
    blend_meta=LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000).fit(np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(Xtr[blend_idx])[:,1] for m in blend_bases]),ytr[blend_idx])
    def proba(name,indices):
        if name=='Stacking manuel':return meta.predict_proba(np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(X[indices])[:,1] for m in bases]))[:,1]
        if name=='Blending':return blend_meta.predict_proba(np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(X[indices])[:,1] for m in blend_bases]))[:,1]
        return candidates[name].predict_proba(X[indices])[:,1]
    names=[name for name in candidates if name!='Hard Voting']+['Stacking manuel','Blending'];rows=[]
    for name in names:rows.append({'model':name,'AUC_validation':roc_auc_score(y[val],proba(name,val))})
    comparison=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('AUC_validation',ascending=False);winner=comparison.iloc[0]['model']
    print(comparison.round(4).to_string(index=False));print('Hard Voting, accuracy validation :',accuracy_score(y[val],candidates['Hard Voting'].predict(X[val])))
    # Décision fixée avant de consulter le test. Les bases de blending restent sur leur sous-train.
    probabilities=proba(winner,test)
    print('Audit final du modèle choisi :',winner,'AUC',roc_auc_score(y[test],probabilities),'Log Loss',log_loss(y[test],probabilities))
    print('Corrélation des erreurs probabilistes sur validation :')
    print(np.corrcoef(np.column_stack([y[val]-m.predict_proba(X[val])[:,1] for m in bases]),rowvar=False))
    return {'winner':winner,'comparison':comparison}

if __name__=='__main__':run()

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def survival_inputs(durations,events):
    durations=np.asarray(durations,dtype=float);events=np.asarray(events)
    if durations.ndim!=1 or not len(durations) or events.shape!=durations.shape or not np.isfinite(durations).all() or np.any(durations<0) or not np.isin(events,[0,1]).all():
        raise ValueError('Durées finies non négatives et événements binaires alignés requis.')
    return durations,events.astype(bool)

def kaplan_meier(durations,events):
    durations,events=survival_inputs(durations,events);survival=1.;rows=[]
    for time in np.unique(durations):
        at_risk=int(np.sum(durations>=time));deaths=int(np.sum((durations==time)&events))
        censored=int(np.sum((durations==time)&~events))
        # Les censures au même temps restent dans le risque lors des événements.
        survival*=1-deaths/at_risk
        rows.append({'time':time,'at_risk':at_risk,'events':deaths,'censored':censored,'survival':survival})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def survival_at(curve,time):
    known=curve[curve['time']<=time]
    return 1. if known.empty else float(known.iloc[-1]['survival'])

def risk_concordance(durations,events,risk):
    durations,events=survival_inputs(durations,events);risk=np.asarray(risk,dtype=float)
    if risk.shape!=durations.shape or not np.isfinite(risk).all():raise ValueError('Risques finis alignés requis.')
    concordant=0.;comparable=0
    # Convention pédagogique : exclure les durées égales ; risque élevé = événement précoce.
    for i in range(len(durations)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(durations)):
            if durations[i]==durations[j]:continue
            early,late=(i,j) if durations[i]<durations[j] else (j,i)
            if events[early]:
                comparable+=1
                concordant+=1. if risk[early]>risk[late] else .5 if risk[early]==risk[late] else 0.
    return concordant/comparable if comparable else np.nan

def run_rsf(train,test):
    # Extension locale optionnelle : python -m pip install scikit-survival
    from sksurv.ensemble import RandomSurvivalForest
    from sksurv.util import Surv
    from sksurv.metrics import concordance_index_censored,integrated_brier_score
    features=[c for c in train if c not in ['week','arrest']]
    y_train=Surv.from_dataframe('arrest','week',train);y_test=Surv.from_dataframe('arrest','week',test)
    rsf=RandomSurvivalForest(n_estimators=100,min_samples_leaf=5,random_state=42,n_jobs=1)
    rsf.fit(train[features],y_train);risk=rsf.predict(test[features])
    score=concordance_index_censored(test['arrest'].astype(bool),test['week'],risk)[0]
    print('RSF test C-index :',score)
    # Horizon strictement dans le support de suivi observé train/test.
    end=min(train['week'].max(),test['week'].max())
    times=np.linspace(max(test['week'].min(),train['week'].min())+1,end-1,20)
    predicted=np.array([fn(times) for fn in rsf.predict_survival_function(test[features])])
    print('IBS IPCW :',integrated_brier_score(y_train,y_test,predicted,times))
    return score

def run(plot=False,rsf=False):
    from lifelines.datasets import load_rossi
    from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter,CoxPHFitter
    from lifelines.utils import concordance_index
    from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test
    from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
    df=load_rossi()
    print('Données Rossi intégrées à lifelines : temps avant arrestation, pas churn client.')
    train,test=train_test_split(df,test_size=.25,stratify=df['arrest'],random_state=42)
    km=KaplanMeierFitter().fit(train['week'],train['arrest'],label='Survie sans événement, train')
    own=kaplan_meier(train['week'],train['arrest'])
    np.testing.assert_allclose([survival_at(own,t) for t in own['time']],km.predict(own['time']).to_numpy())
    model=CoxPHFitter(penalizer=.01).fit(train,duration_col='week',event_col='arrest')
    features=[c for c in df if c not in ['week','arrest']]
    risk=model.predict_partial_hazard(test[features]).to_numpy().ravel()
    cindex=concordance_index(test['week'],-risk,test['arrest'])
    print('Test C-index lifelines (signe de risque inversé) :',cindex)
    print('Hazard ratios associés :');print(model.hazard_ratios_)
    print('Diagnostic des risques proportionnels sur train :')
    model.check_assumptions(train,p_value_threshold=.05,show_plots=False)
    a,b=train[train['fin']==0],train[train['fin']==1]
    print('Log-rank descriptif sur train :',logrank_test(a['week'],b['week'],event_observed_A=a['arrest'],event_observed_B=b['arrest']).p_value)
    individual=model.predict_survival_function(test[features].iloc[[0]])
    if rsf:run_rsf(train,test)
    if plot:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        km.plot_survival_function();plt.title('Kaplan-Meier sur train');plt.show()
        individual.plot();plt.title('Survie individuelle sur test');plt.show()
    return {'C_index':cindex,'survival_curve':individual}

if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--plot',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--rsf',action='store_true')
    args=parser.parse_args();run(args.plot,args.rsf)
